title: boehmeria nivea
intro: Boehmeria nivea, commonly known as Chinese mulberry or sacred lotus of the south, is a perennial herb native to Asia. It is valued for its medicinal properties, providing various health benefits including anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial effects. The therapeutic actions of Boehmeria nivea include reducing fever, alleviating rheumatism and arthritis symptoms, and acting as a diuretic, making it useful in treating various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of Boehmeria nivea include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and triterpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties and potential health benefits.
